title: Your Significance and Purpose Within the Body of Christ
titleZh: 你在基督身體裡的重要性與目的
partTitleZh: 開場問候與弄丟車鑰匙笑話
summaryZh: 講員問候會眾並分享服事地下教會的心得，接著以一則弄丟車輛的幽默笑話溫暖全場。
lines: And when God defines you and me as members of one whole, there is a depth to it that can only be known through sacrifice.
當神將你我定義為一個整體的肢體時，其中蘊含著一種唯有透過犧牲才能體會的深度。
I cannot fully understand who I am as a member of the body of Christ until my fellowship demands something of me.
除非我的團契生活向我提出要求，否則我無法完全明白身為基督身體肢體的我是誰。
If I only do what is convenient, then I am the boss.
如果我只做方便的事，那我就是老大。
And that is not the lordship of Jesus; it is the lordship of my religious views.
那就不是耶穌的主權，而是我個人宗教觀點的主權。
Well, good day; it's so nice to see you.
大家日安，很高興見到你們。
I don't know what your week was like, but man, it was a very busy week.
我不知道你們這週過得如何，但天哪，這真是非常忙碌的一週。
There are busy weeks, and there are busy weeks that are turning points.
有些週很忙碌，但也有些忙碌的週是生命中的轉捩點。
那樣的週甚至更加充實緊湊。
And it was a wonderful, just wonderful week.
這真是一個美好、無比美好的一週。
I managed to spend time online with about a few thousand underground pastors from a place where it is forbidden.
我設法在線上與幾千名來自信仰受禁地區的地下教會牧師互動交流。
And it was a great honor to serve them, and it's amazing what you can do online.
能服事他們是莫大的榮幸，而且在線上能做成的事真的很不可思議。
And what they do to hide their identities is also impressive.
他們為了隱藏身分所付出的努力也令人敬佩。
令人敬佩的；令人印象深刻的
But it's a great honor to just love God's people around the world, and I'm glad we're together today.
但能去愛神在世界各地的子民是極大的榮幸，我也很高興我們今天能聚在一起。
Glad you're here, and I've enjoyed the worship so much.
很高興你們在這裡，我非常享受這場敬拜。
I have something very important to read to you, and you will be built up and strengthened after it.
我有非常重要的內容要讀給你們聽，聽完之後你們會得著造就與堅固。
A few days ago I left a meeting at a hotel.
幾天前，我離開了在飯店的一場會議。
I desperately began to search myself, as if I were being searched at an airport.
我開始慌亂地上下搜身，好像在機場接受安檢搜身一樣。
I was looking for my keys.
A quick search of the boardroom yielded nothing.
快速搜尋了會議室後一無所獲。
Suddenly I realized that I must have left them in the car.
突然我意識到，我一定是把鑰匙忘在車上了。
I ran frantically to the parking lot.
我慌慌張張地衝向停車場。
My husband has scolded me many times for leaving the keys in the ignition.
我丈夫曾多次責備我總是把鑰匙插在點火開關上。
My theory is that the ignition is the best place to keep them from getting lost.
我的理論是，點火開關是防止鑰匙弄丟的最佳位置。
His theory is that the car will be stolen.
他的理論則是車子會被偷走。
As I flew out the door, I came to a terrible conclusion.
當我疾奔出門時，我得出了一個可怕的結論。
I told them my location, admitted that I had left my keys in the car and that it had been stolen.
我告訴他們我的位置，承認我把鑰匙留在車上，而且車子被偷了。
Then I made the hardest call of all.
接著我打了所有電話當中最難開口的一通。
I always call him "darling" at times like this.
在這種大難臨頭的時刻，我總會叫他「親愛的」。
"I left my keys in the car and it was stolen."
「我把鑰匙忘在車裡，車子被偷了。」
There was a pause of silence.
電話那頭一陣短暫的沉默。
I thought the connection had been lost, but then I heard his voice.
我以為電話斷線了，但隨後聽到了他的聲音。
Now is my time to be silent.
I said nonchalantly, "Well, will you come pick me up?"
我若無其事地說：「嗯，那你要來接我嗎？」
若無其事地；滿不在乎地
He replied, "I'll come as soon as I convince this policeman that I didn't steal your car."
他回答：「只要我向這位警察解釋清楚我沒有偷妳的車，我就過去。」
是的，我很喜歡這個幽默故事。
